insights.title: Gen Z shops, older generations buy groceries
insights.text: Gen Z puts 22% of spend into shopping and 9% into grocery, while Boomers put 13% into shopping and 19% into grocery (epsilon squared 0.27 and 0.15).

insights.title: Gen Z is the most online generation
insights.text: Gen Z makes 42% of its channel-tagged spend online against 33% for Millennials and 30% for Boomers (epsilon squared 0.15).

insights.title: Gen Z swipes often for small amounts
insights.text: Gen Z makes 106 transactions a month at a median ticket of $25, while Boomers make 61 at $42 (epsilon squared 0.07 for frequency, 0.01 for ticket).

insights.title: Gen X and Millennials carry the most spend per customer
insights.text: Median monthly spend is $6,026 for Millennials and $5,726 for Gen X, against $3,926 for Boomers and $3,973 for Silent (epsilon squared 0.08).

insights.title: Travel share of wallet does not depend on generation
insights.text: Median travel share of wallet runs from 0.9% for Gen Z to 2.7% for Silent and the difference is not reliable (epsilon squared 0.009, p = 0.09), so a travel benefit should be targeted on behavior, not on age.
